versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "nutrition-and-health" skill.
- Provides personalized nutrition, eating, and wellness advice for various daily and special scenarios.
- Covers meal, drink, diet, gut health, fitness, and seasonal recommendations in both Chinese and English.
- Enables user profile creation for tailored suggestions based on health needs, preferences, and habits.
- Emphasizes user privacy: all information is local and not uploaded.
- Designed for all ages and needs, including weight loss, fitness, gut health, and everyday wellness.
